text: {"lessons":["I sold several winners, then bought some of those stocks back at much higher prices; before repurchasing, I should reassess the company and price rather than chase what I previously sold.","My account fell substantially while I made no trades, reminding me that rarely checking should not mean neglecting risk; I should review whether my holdings still fit my plan.","I should avoid letting the pain of selling at a loss—or the pleasure of taking a gain—decide for me; use consistent reasons for holding, buying, or selling."]}
